reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the supplied eight allowed record identifiers and performs exact need-to-capability handoffs: records n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r06, and n06-r08 are marked direct with matching capability IDs, while n06-r01 and n06-r07 remain unsupported.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage is direct. The declared role requires unsupported needs to rank before covered needs, but the output ranks covered direct needs n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r06, and n06-r08 before genuinely unsupported n06-r01 and n06-r07. This is behaviorally significant because it changes priority ordering and feeds the recommendation.

synthesize_recommendation appears to retain the eight-item window and derive the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record as declared. Its observed recommendation is contaminated by the upstream prioritize_needs fault, so the boundary is not independently failed on the supplied evidence.
